name: @antora-supplemental/antora-search-chat
description: Antora extension that wraps @antora/lunr-extension with a Search/Ask omnibox. Lunr answers first, and lunr is not forked.

antoraRegistry.longDescription:
The omnibox puts Search and Ask in one box on top of @antora/lunr-extension. Lunr results always come first, and the extension wraps lunr instead of forking it.

Two extra answer tiers are optional. A local tier-0 answers from the built site, and a remote backend handles questions the local tiers cannot. Without them, the omnibox behaves as plain Lunr search.
